corrections.name: Mega City
corrections.proposed: Mon-Thu 10:00-23:00; Fri-Sat 10:00-00:00 (site text says 12pm, almost certainly meaning midnight); Sun 10:00-23:00
corrections.evidence_quote: Opening times: Mon 10am to 11pm Tue 10am to 11pm Wed 10am to 11pm Thurs 10am to 11pm Fri 10am to 12pm Sat 10am to 12pm Sun 10am to 11pm. Location: 233/249 High St, Slough SL1 1BY.
corrections.note: Official page is clear Mon-Thu and Sun close 11pm, not 01:00 as the app shows. Fri/Sat printed as 12pm which is almost certainly a midnight typo on their site (noon close would be absurd for this venue); app Fri-Sat 00:00 is the plausible reading. Venue itself confirmed open; ZIv 2026-07-12 lists DanceDanceRevolution WORLD.
